Message.Name: Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Auction Update messages disseminate Cboe price and size information during auctions for Cboe listed securities and for CMC.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction Type

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: BBO Collared auction price.

Field.Name: Buy Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares on buy side at the Reference Price. Shares matched for Cboe Market Close session.

Field.Name: Sell Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares on sell side at the Reference Price. Shares matched for Cboe Market Close session.

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: Price at which the auction book and the continuous book would match.

Field.Name: Auction Only Price
Field.Description: Price at which the auction book would match using only Eligible Auction Orders.

Message.Description: The extended version of the Auction Update message accommodates larger prices.

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: Auction Summary messages disseminate the results of a Cboe listed security auction and for Cboe Market Close.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction Type

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price or CMC match price.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares executed during the auction or CMC matching session.

Message.Description: The extended version of the Auction Summary message accommodates larger prices.

Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price. Price of the CMC match.

Field.Name: Shares
